# Empathy Laser Clinic — Delhi NCR

> Premier aesthetic dermatology and laser clinic in Pitampura, Delhi NCR. 15+ years of experience, 25,000+ clients treated. USFDA-cleared devices including Lumenis LightSheer Desire, Alma Soprano ICE Platinum, and CoolSculpting Elite.

Empathy Skin & Laser Hair Removal Clinic is led by Dr. Jyoti Anand (Chief Dermatologist) and Dr. Rajnish Anand (Hair Transplant Surgeon). The clinic specializes in evidence-based aesthetic and dermatology treatments tailored for Indian skin types. All consultations are quote-based; please contact the clinic for pricing.

## Core Services

- [Laser Hair Removal Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/laser-hair-removal-delhi): Permanent laser hair reduction using Lumenis LightSheer Desire (diode) and Alma Soprano ICE Platinum (triple-wavelength). Safe for all Indian skin types (Fitzpatrick I–VI).
- [CoolSculpting Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/coolsculpting-delhi): FDA-cleared non-surgical fat freezing with CoolSculpting Elite. ~27% fat-cell reduction per cycle for abdomen, flanks, thighs, arms, double chin.
- [Weight Loss Clinic Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/weight-loss-clinic-delhi): Non-surgical medical weight loss and body-contouring programs.
- [Skin Clinic Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/skin-clinic-delhi): Comprehensive dermatology — pigmentation, acne, anti-ageing, skin tightening.
- [Botox & Fillers Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/botox-fillers-delhi): Anti-wrinkle injections and dermal fillers from qualified physicians.
- [HIFU Treatment Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/hifu-treatment-delhi): Non-surgical face lift with High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound.
- [Hair Transplant Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/hair-transplant-delhi): FUE and FUT hair-transplant procedures.
- [Hair Loss Treatment Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/hair-loss-treatment-delhi): PRP therapy and medical hair-loss management.
- [Acne Treatment Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/acne-treatment-delhi): Active acne, post-acne scars, and pigmentation management.
- [Skin Lightening Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/skin-lightening-delhi): Pigmentation, melasma, and skin-tone correction.
- [Anti-Ageing Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/anti-ageing-delhi): Wrinkle reduction, collagen induction, skin rejuvenation.
- [Dark Circles Treatment Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/dark-circles-treatment-delhi): Under-eye pigmentation and hollows.
- [Body Contouring Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/body-contouring-delhi): Non-surgical body shaping.
- [Tattoo Removal Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/tattoo-removal-delhi): Q-switched Nd:YAG laser tattoo removal for all ink colors.
- [Stretch Marks Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/stretch-marks-delhi): Fractional laser stretch-mark reduction.
- [Bridal Packages Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/bridal-packages-delhi): Pre-wedding skin, hair, and body programs.
- [Facials & HydraFacial Delhi](https://empathylaserclinic.com/laser-treatments/facials-delhi): Medical-grade facial treatments.
